topic: A draft the app saves from an agent's draft is recorded as the operator's
detail: From SP-054's security review (accepted as Low). 'Drop invalid lines' saves the rest of a draft as a new revision through SetSpacesDraft, which orchd records as the operator's (Orch.app is the operator, D-71), so the agent's authorship drops out of the record and accept_agent_draft is no longer asked for it. The app therefore requires 'I reviewed this draft' before it drops lines from an agent's draft. Server-side fix: SetSpacesDraft takes the revision it derives from and keeps its by-agent flag, so orchd still requires accept_agent_draft (orchd.proto change).
